persona.title: Pretend you are…
persona.text: Pretend you are Grace, 45, a volunteer trustee at Hope Community Church, a small church in Texas, USA. A trustee is a volunteer who looks after the church building and its money. Last year the church paid a fine because nobody remembered the fire extinguisher check, and today the pastor has asked you to put every important date in one place.

lines: Welcome. This short video explains an app called Ahead of It, Church. You have never seen it before, and that is fine. In about four minutes you will know what it is for and how to use it.
The app is American, so we will explain some American words.

First, the problem. A church building has many dates that must not be missed. The fire extinguishers must be checked every year. The church van must be registered with the government every year. The building insurance must be renewed.

Usually only one person remembers these dates. That person is often a trustee. A trustee is a volunteer who looks after the church building and its money. When that person is sick, or moves away, the dates are forgotten.
A missed date can cost real money. A fine. Insurance that stops. Sometimes the building is even closed until the problem is fixed.
Ahead of It keeps all these dates on one calm page. It shows what is coming next, and it reminds you thirty days before something is due.
One thing about money. The app shows dollars, because it is American. If you like, you can think in shillings.
Now let us look at the screens. At the bottom of the page there are four tabs: Next, Year, Library and Hand-off.

lines.t: Start with Library. It is a ready-made list of twenty four things churches often forget, like the fire extinguisher service, the boiler inspection and the van registration. Tap one, and it is added to your list.
Or tap the yellow button, Quick setup. It shows the whole library with tick boxes. Tick what your church has, and tap Save.
Now tap Next. This is your main page. Things are sorted by what needs you first: Overdue at the top, then Do something now, then Next 90 days, then Later this year.

lines: Tap the words of any item to open it. Here you can change the date in the box called Next due. You can choose how often it repeats, for example Yearly.
You choose how bad it is to miss: No big deal, A hassle, or Costs real money. You can write who else needs to know, for example the treasurer, the person who keeps the church money. Then tap Save.

lines.t: Something not in the library? Tap the round orange button with the plus sign. You type your own item, with its own date, and tap Save.

lines: Each item on the list has buttons. When a reminder step is due, you see step tick. When the whole job is finished, for example the van is registered, tap done tick. The app moves the date to next time, so it repeats by itself.

lines.t: The Year tab shows twelve months on one page. Red means a miss costs real money. Amber means a hassle. Green means no big deal.

The Hand-off tab is for the day you are not there. It prints one page that another person can use: what is due, who to tell, and where the papers are. Here you also write whose list this is, for example the name of the church.

lines: Everything stays on this phone. There is no account and nothing is sent to anyone.
To start again with an empty list, scroll to the very bottom of the page and tap Start fresh. The app asks you twice before it erases anything.
In the test, you will look after a small church building in America. Take your time, and if something is confusing, say so. Confusing parts are exactly what we want to find.

challenge.intro: Now you are Grace, the trustee. The app is empty. Nobody will tell you which button to press — use what you learned. When you finish, tap Check my work.
challenge.start: Open Ahead of It · Church with the normal link (not the 🧪 test copy). If the welcome tour shows, tap 'skip the tour' → '✨ Start fresh with my own' → OK. If it does not show, scroll to the very bottom of the page and tap '🧹 Start fresh — erase this app’s data' → OK → OK. The page reloads. If a dark screen says 'Everyone has a list of things…', tap 'I'll explore on my own' at the bottom. You now see an empty list ('empty' at the top). If a small 'Got it ✓' box appears when you open a tab, just tap it. (Verified 10 Oct: all five checks false after this.)

tasks.text: Put the fire extinguisher service on your list. This year the company is coming on 20 November 2026 — make that its date.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('steward_v1')||'null');if(!d||!d.items)return false;var f=function(s){return d.items.filter(function(i){return String(i.id).indexOf('djex')!==0&&String(i.n||'').toLowerCase().indexOf(s)>=0})[0]};var i=f('fire extinguisher');return !!i&&i.due==='2026-11-20';}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: It is in the Library under Safety & inspections. After adding it, open it on the Next page and change 'Next due', then Save.

tasks.text: Put the church van registration on your list, and make sure the Treasurer (the person who keeps the church money) is told about it.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('steward_v1')||'null');if(!d||!d.items)return false;var f=function(s){return d.items.filter(function(i){return String(i.id).indexOf('djex')!==0&&String(i.n||'').toLowerCase().indexOf(s)>=0})[0]};var i=f('van registration');return !!i&&String(i.who||'').toLowerCase().indexOf('treasurer')>=0;}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Add it from the Library (Vehicles). Open it and look for the box 'Who else needs to know'.

tasks.text: The church generator is not in the library. Add it yourself: 'Generator service', due 15 January 2027. If it is missed, it costs real money.
tasks.hint: Use the round orange ＋ button. Fill in the name and date, and choose how bad it is to miss.

tasks.text: The boiler inspection was finished today. Put it on your list and tell the app the whole job is done, so it moves to next time.
tasks.hint: Add it from the Library, then find it on the Next page. Saving it is not enough — one of its buttons says the job is finished.

tasks.text: If you are ever away, another person will use this list. Write on it that it belongs to Hope Community Church.
tasks.hint: Look in the Hand-off tab, in the box 'Whose list is this?'. Tap outside the box after typing.

ownWords.question: In your own words, what is this app for?
keyIdeas: keeps all the important dates of a church building in one place
reminds you before something is due, so you do not pay a fine or lose insurance
another person can take over using the hand-off list

daily.task: Add or update one date in Ahead of It · Church — for example a fire-extinguisher check.
